title: Swiss Alps Miniature Railway - (Work in Progress)
author: Protocontext
selftext:
Hey everyone! I'm a huge fan of logic games and train puzzles, so a few weeks ago I started developing a small game inspired by Mini Metro, but set in the beautiful Swiss Alps.

The idea is simple, you control trains across a railway network, managing routes and traffic to keep everything running smoothly, all with a cozy miniature diorama style, like a little model railway coming to life!!

It's still in development (although it's already a pretty playable prototype) and so far I'm the only one playing it to test the mechanics, but I'm genuinely finding it incredibly fun and addictive. I've been testing it on both my PC and iPad and, my God, I absolutely love it!

Here's a short gameplay video showing how it works, I'd really love to hear your thoughts and what you think of the idea!
